info.name: Home4Paws - M2 Authorization Test Suite
info.description:
SE4030 Member 2 (T.H.N.Nadushka, IT23294202). Access-control test matrix for V02, V03, V04, V05, V14.
Tests named 'SECURE:' assert the SECURE behaviour, so on the ORIGINAL code they FAIL (proving the vulnerability) and after the fixes they PASS. Tests named 'FUNCTIONAL:' check that legitimate access still works.
Run the whole collection in order with the Collection Runner. Requires the local stack (see MEMBER2_PLAN.md). Set adminEmail/adminPassword as the CURRENT value of the collection variables locally (never commit a real password). Set Postman Settings > Working directory to this security-tests folder so test-pet.png is found. See security-tests/README.md.

item.name: 00 Setup (run first)
Init run id (unique escalation-victim email per run)

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("userCEmail", `m2.userc.${Date.now()}@test.local`);
pm.test("setup: API reachable", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test("setup: login succeeded", () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
const j = pm.response.json();
// After V09 the access token is only sent as the httpOnly cookie h4p_at (not in the body)
const sc = pm.response.headers.all().filter(h => h.key.toLowerCase() === 'set-cookie').map(h => h.value).find(v => v.startsWith('h4p_at='));
pm.test('setup: access-token cookie h4p_at received', () => pm.expect(sc).to.be.a('string'));
pm.collectionVariables.set("adminToken", sc ? sc.split(";")[0].substring(7) : "");
pm.collectionVariables.set("adminId", j.user.id);

item.description: Logs in the seeded admin, creates/logs in userA and userB, a fresh userC, a category, and three pet reports owned by userA.

exec: pm.test("SECURE: anonymous must NOT receive the user list", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 403, 404]));
pm.test("SECURE: normal user must NOT receive the user list", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 403, 404]));
pm.test("SECURE: status must be 401", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401]));
pm.test("SECURE: status must be 403", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: admin can list users", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));

item.name: V03 Pet reports: missing authorization + IDOR

exec: pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: public listing still works", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));

item.name: [V03] Anonymous POST /api/reports (anonymous reporting allowed by design)

formdata.value: Created by Member 2 authorization test suite

exec: pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: anonymous lost/found reporting still works", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([201]));
pm.test("SECURE: anonymous cannot edit a report", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401]));
pm.test("SECURE: userB cannot edit userA's report (IDOR)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("SECURE: only admins can edit reports", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: admin can edit a pending report", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("SECURE: anonymous cannot delete a report", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401]));
pm.test("SECURE: userB cannot delete userA's report (IDOR)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("SECURE: only admins can delete reports", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: admin can delete a pending report", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([204]));
pm.test("SECURE: anonymous cannot read a user's reports", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401]));
pm.test("SECURE: userB cannot read userA's reports (IDOR)", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: user can call the endpoint for their own id", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
pm.test("SECURE: anonymous cannot change report status", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401]));
pm.test("SECURE: only admins can change report status", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([403]));
pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: admin can change status", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));

pm.test("SECURE: anonymous cannot promote a user to Admin", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([401, 403, 404]));
pm.test("SECURE: userC must still have role User", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().user.role).to.eql("User"));

pm.test("FUNCTIONAL: admin can run session cleanup", () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200]));
